description: This file implements Bonjour (mDNS) service advertisement for a gateway, including functions for starting/stopping advertising, handling service state, and watchdog mechanisms for re-advertising in case of issues.

methods.name: isDisabledByEnv
methods.description: Checks environment variables to determine if Bonjour advertising should be disabled.

methods.name: safeServiceName
methods.description: Sanitizes and provides a default name for Bonjour services.

methods.name: prettifyInstanceName
methods.description: Normalizes and formats the instance name for display.

methods.name: serviceSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary string for a Bonjour service, including FQDN, hostname, port, and state.

methods.name: isAnnouncedState
methods.description: Checks if a service state is 'announced'.

methods.name: handleCiaoUnhandledRejection
methods.description: Handles unhandled rejections from ciao, classifying and logging them.

methods.name: shouldSuppressCiaoConsoleLog
methods.description: Determines if console logs should be suppressed based on message content.

methods.name: installCiaoConsoleNoiseFilter
methods.description: Overrides console.log to filter out specific noisy messages.

methods.name: startGatewayBonjourAdvertiser
methods.description: Main function to initialize and start Bonjour advertisement for the gateway, including watchdog and re-advertising logic.
